topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can’t believe this is happening. I thought they were all just a few hours away from giving me the biggest surprise of the year. I had this vision of walking into the room, seeing everyone pop up from behind the curtains and the couches, laughing, hugging... But now, I find myself staring at a text that says it’s all off. I tried to ask why, but no one’s really giving me a straight answer. It’s just so confusing, and I keep refreshing my phone, hoping for some mistake, some turn this around. Maybe it’s not too late? Maybe there’s a way to fix this?
